messages.title: Non-Spin deployed
messages.text: ERCOT deployed Non-Spin at 100% of awards from 17:36 to 19:16.

messages.content: I’ll build a day-ahead book that uses the battery for the morning and evening peaks, earns reserve revenue where headroom permits, and preserves the required closing charge. Then I’ll monitor each watch and adjust energy dispatch as conditions change.

Overnight regulation-down charging was lower than forecast, leaving the battery below its planned charge. I’ll add midday charging to restore support for the evening reserve awards; the frozen morning awards remain unchanged.

The battery is now full. ERCOT’s Non-Spin deployment does not directly draw from us because we hold no Non-Spin awards. I’ll retain the committed peak dispatch and reduce the 20:00 discharge slightly to cushion the closing charge against uncertain regulation drift.
